selection: Eight fixed scientific information-extraction papers chosen by train-side METHOD/TASK/DATASET support imbalance and entity boundary need, not held-out names or predictions. GLiNER/RoBERTa rejected by identity metadata, not assigned to train. Selection occurs before fresh source/annotation/predictions. Targeted NLP training is biased and not a representative evaluation sample.
identityPolicy: Reject exact arXiv IDs and normalized title overlaps with the entire20k corpus, original abstract selection metadata, current train/dev identities and supplementary dev identities. Reserved test content never opened; metadata-only exclusion plus binary integrity checks.
annotation: Whole abstract AI labels and actual same-session source self-review. Same three typed classes and flat BIO scope as44/45; specific task phrases retain modifiers. Original raw Unicode spans; no title labels, global dictionary or partial-word labels. Shared-head/nested ambiguity is quarantined, not silently repaired.
relationPolicy: NER-only supplementation: all new relation candidates explicitly UNRESOLVED, no new RE gradient or invented NO_RELATION. Original271 train relations byte-identical.
